nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query derived from a short message.

A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources providing that type, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.
A classification of context data determined algorithmically from the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.
An entity or provider that supplies context data of a given context-data type and can be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

A message content to which relevant context data is linked and formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms are analyzed to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, or forwarded along with the short message.
A device that generates a short message and a query, and to which received context data may be provided; may be a smart phone.

A computing device used by the context-data provider to collect the set of context-data.<SEP>A computing system that receives short messages from mobile devices, determines context-data types, identifies and ranks context-data sources, and generates requests for context data.
A mobile device that receives context data, possibly associated with or appended to a short message, or a URI of a database server.

A criterion used to rank context-data sources or select context data, including pecuniary cost, state of the receiving mobile device, state of an available communication network, and cost value of the context data.
A monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.
A storage system available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored and queried via metadata instructions.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to locate stored context data.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations for context-data acquisition and ranking.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the context-data acquisition and ranking method.
A device by which the context-data is obtained.<SEP>A sensor by which context data related to the meaning of short message content is obtained.

An entity with at least one server that collects and provides a set of context-data, and is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to the meaning of short message content is collected by a server.

A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context data, comprising a monetary cost of the context-data.<SEP>A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context data, including a monetary cost of the context data.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A network through which context data is rendered for communication to a mobile device, and whose state may serve as a specified parameter.
Data elements related to the meaning of a short message content, obtained by a physical sensor and provided by context-data providers, weighted and selected according to at least one metric.
The cost of the context-data, used as a metric for selecting relevant context data.
A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type, ranks it according to a specified parameter, and generates a request for context data from it.
The method receives a short message, determines context-data type from its terms, and may append received context data to the short message.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device and provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method is performed with a server that receives short messages and manages context-data acquisition.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device.
The method ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The computerized apparatus executes program instructions to perform the operations of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The computer readable medium comprises computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the context-data acquisition and ranking method.
Context data related to the meaning of short message content is obtained by a physical sensor.
A set of context data related to the meaning of short message content is collected from at least one context-data provider with a server.
Relevant context data is algorithmically selected according to a metric.
Received context data is associated with a component of a short message and forwarded to the recipient mobile device.
The relevant context data is linked to the short message and is related to the meaning of the short message content.
The relevant context data and the short message are formatted according to a communication protocol.
The short message is generated by the device whose physical context the context data relates to.
The mobile device that generated the short message may comprise a smart phone.
The context-data provider uses at least one server to collect the set of context-data.
The specified parameter comprises a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from the context-data source.
The state of an available communication network may serve as a specified parameter for ranking.
The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context data.
A Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server is forwarded to the receiving mobile device to locate the database.
The context-data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The context-data provider, with at least one server, collects and provides a set of context-data related to the meaning of a short message content.
The context-data provider is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.
The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context-data.
Relevant context data is algorithmically selected according to a metric, and context-data elements are weighted according to at least one metric.
The relevant context data and the short message are formatted according to a communication protocol.
The context data is related to a physical context of the device that generated the short message.
The communication protocol comprises a cellular network short message protocol.
The communication protocol comprises an internet communication protocol.
